name: PowerPurchaseAgreementTracker
tagline: PPA deliveries, curtailment, settlement and invoice reconciliation in one plug-and-play Power Apps control.
description: A complete power purchase agreement (PPA) settlement app for canvas, model-driven and Power Pages: contract portfolio roll-up, monthly delivered vs contracted volume, compensable curtailment, expected settlement for physical, sleeved and virtual PPAs, invoice variance checks with tolerance and dual approval, disputes, holds, payment terms and a counterparty portal.
features: Delivery % vs P50 and guaranteed-output shortfall
Bulk approve / pay / hold, CSV export, undo
controlType: standard (2 controls: PowerPurchaseAgreementTracker data-set + PowerPurchaseAgreementTrackerPortal field control)
